questions.question: A reduction of 12(1)/(2) % in the price of an item enables a person to buy 2.5 kg more for Rs. 280. The reduced price of the item per kg is:
questions.solution:

Percentage of price reduced = 12.5%

Quantity of buying increased = 2.5 kg

**Concept**

Price per Kg = Total amount/Quantity(in Kg)

**Calculation**

Let the quantity purchased for Rs 280 is x kg

Price = 280/x

New price = [(280/x) - 12.5% of (280/x)]

New quantity purchased at reduced price = (x + 2.5)kg

According to question

 [(280/x) - 12.5% of (280/x)] × (x + 2.5) = 280

⇒ [(280/x) - (35/x)] × (x + 2.5) = 280

⇒ [(280 - 35)/x] × (x + 2.5) = 280

⇒ (245/x) × (x + 2.5) = 280

⇒ (245x + 612.5)/x = 280

⇒ 245x + 612.5 = 280x

⇒ 612.5 = 280x - 245x

⇒ 612.5 = 35x

⇒ 612.5/35 = x

⇒ 17.5 = x

New price = [(280/x) - 12.5% of (280/x)]

⇒ [(280/17.5) - 12.5% of (280/17.5)]

⇒ 16 - 12.5% of 16

⇒ 16 - 2

⇒ 14

**∴ Reduced price is Rs.14 per kg.**

questions.question: A and B can do a work in 12 days and 18 days, respectively. They worked together for 4 days, after which B was replaced by C and the remaining work was completed by A and C in the next 4 days. In how many days will C alone complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Work done by A alone = 12 days

Work done by B alone = 18 days

**Concept**

Find the total work by taking the LCM of the days taken by A and B to complete the work.

**Formula used**

Work done = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation**

Total work(LCM of 12 and 18) = 36 units

Work done by A in one day = 36/12

⇒ 3 units

Work done by B in one day = 36/18

⇒ 2 units

Work done by A and B in one day = 3 + 2 

⇒ 5 units

Work done by A and B in 4 days = 4 × 5

⇒ 20 units

Work left after 4 days = 36 - 20

⇒ 16 units

let work done by C in one day is x units

Remaining work done by A and C in 4 days = 16 units

4 × 3 + 4 × x = 16

⇒ 12 + 4x = 16

⇒ 4x = 16 - 12

⇒ 4x = 4

⇒ x = 1 unit

work = efficiency × time

36 = 1 × time

36 days = Time

**∴ Work is complete by C alone in 36 days.**

questions.question: The curved surface area of a cone is (3432)/(7) cm² and its radius is 12 cm. What is the radius of a sphere whose volume is 1.2 times the volume of the cone? (Take π = (22)/(7) )
questions.solution:
**Given**

Curved surface area of a cone = (3432)/(7) cm2 and its radius is 12 cm

**Formula used**

Curved surface area of cone = πrl

where r and l are radius and slant height of the cone respectively

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr²h

**Calculation**

πrl = (3432/7)

⇒ (22/7) × 12 × l = (3432/7)

⇒ l = (3432)/(22 × 12)

⇒ l = 13

h = √l² - r²

⇒ h = √(13)² - (12)²

⇒ h = √169 - 144

⇒ h = √25

⇒ h = 5

Volume of sphere = 1.2 × volume of cone

⇒ (4/3) × π × r³ = 1.2 × (1/3) × π × 12² × h

⇒ 4r³ = 1.2 × 12 × 12 × 5

⇒ r³ = (1.2 × 12 × 12 × 5)/4

⇒ r³ = 216

⇒ r = 6 cm

**∴ Radius of sphere is 6 cm**

 Average monthly expenditure of a family for 3 months = Rs. 15,000

 family saves Rs. 1,52,000

questions.question: A sum of Rs. x amounts to Rs. 27,900 in 3 years and to Rs. 41,850 in 6 years at a certain rate percent per annum when the interest is compounded yearly. The value of x is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Principles = x

Amount = 27,900

**Formula used**

Amount = Principal(1 + Rate%)t

where t represents time respectively

**Calculation**

27,900 = x(1 + r%)³

⇒ 27,900/x = (1 + r%)³ ---- (1)

41,850 = x(1+ r%)⁶

⇒ 41,850/x = [(1 + r%)³)²] (from 1)

41,850/x = (27900/x)²

⇒ (41,850/x) = (27900 × 27900)/(x × x)

⇒ 41850 = (27900 × 27900)/x

⇒ x = (27,900 × 27,900)/(41850)

⇒ x = 18,600 

**∴ The value of x is Rs.18,600**

 Average speed of train = 160% of the average speed of a car

questions.question: (11)/(5) of a number A is 22% of a number B. The number B is equal to 2.5% of a third number, C. If the value of number C is 5500, then the sum of 40% of A and 20% of B is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

B = 2.5% of 5500 = 137.5.

11/5 of A = 2.2A = 22% of B = 0.22B ⇒ A = 0.1B.

Required Sum = 40% of A + 20% of B = 4% of B + 20% of B = 24% of B.

Sum = 0.24 × 137.5 = 33.

**∴ The correct answer is 33.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** C = 5500, B = 2.5% of C, 11/5 of A = 22% of B.

**Formula Used:** X% of Y = (X × Y) ÷ 100.

 
 C = 5500

 A = 13.75
 Target: 0.4A + 0.2B = 5.5 + 27.5 = 33

⇒ B = (2.5 ÷ 100) × 5500 = 137.5

⇒ (11 ÷ 5) × A = (22 ÷ 100) × 137.5

⇒ 2.2 × A = 0.22 × 137.5

⇒ 2.2 × A = 30.25

⇒ A = 30.25 ÷ 2.2 = 13.75

⇒ 40% of A = 0.4 × 13.75 = 5.5

⇒ 20% of B = 0.2 × 137.5 = 27.5

⇒ Sum = 5.5 + 27.5 = 33

**∴ The correct answer is 33.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction

To simplify calculations, convert common percentages to fractions: 20% = 1/5, 40% = 2/5, and 2.5% = 1/40.

Multi-Variable Percentage Relations

If A = x% of B and B = y% of C, then A = (x × y ÷ 100)% of C.

Fractional Coefficients

A coefficient like 11/5 can be treated as a decimal 2.2 for easier division against percentage values like 22%.</p

questions.question:
The ratio of the curved surface area and total surface area of a cylinder is 4 ∶ 7. If its volume is 4851 cm³, then its radius is:

(Take π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given**

ratio of the curved surface area and total surface area of a cylinder is 4 ∶ 7.

Volume of cylinder = 4851 c**m³**

**Formula used**

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh

Total surface area of cylinder = 2πrh + 2πr²

**Calculation**

2πrh/(2πrh + 2πr²) = 4/7

⇒ 2πrh/[2πr(h + r)] = 4/7

⇒ h/(h + r) = 4/7

⇒ 7h = 4h + 4r

⇒ 7h - 4h = 4r

⇒ 3h = 4r

⇒ 3h/4 = r

πr²h = 4851

(22/7) × (3h/4)² × h = 4851

⇒ (22/7) × [(9h²)/16] × h = 4851

⇒ (22 × 9 × h³)/(7 × 16) = 4851

⇒ h³ = (4851 × 7 × 16)/(22 × 9)

⇒ h³ = (1617 × 16 × 7)/(22 × 3)

⇒ h³ = 2744

⇒ h = 14 cm

radius = (3 × 14)/4

⇒ radius = 3 × 3.5

⇒ radius = 10.5 cm

**∴ The radius of cylinder is 10.5 cm**

questions.question: The LCM and HCF of two positive numbers are 96 and 8, respectively. If the sum of the numbers is 56, then the difference between the numbers is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Sum of two numbers = 56

LCM = 96

HCF = **8**

**Concept**

Product of two numbers = Product of LCM and HCM

**Calculation**

Let the one number is x and second number is (56 - x)

x × (56 - x) = 96 × 8

⇒ 56x - x² = 768

⇒ -x² + 56x = 768

⇒ -x² + 56x - 768 = 0

⇒ x² - 56x + 768 = 0

⇒ x² - 24x - 32x + 768 = 0

⇒ x(x - 24) - 32(x - 24) = 0

⇒ (x - 32) (x - 24) = 0

⇒ x = 32 and 24

Required difference = 32 - 24

⇒ 8

**∴ The difference between the number is 8.**

Loss = Cost price - selling price, when Selling price is less than cost price

selling price = (4/7) × 14,000

questions.question: If the ratio of the mean and median of a certain data is 4 ∶ 5, then the ratio of its mode and mean is:

Ratio of mean and median = 4 ∶ 5

**Formula used**

Mode = 3 Median - 2 Mean

**Calculation**

let the mean is 4x and median is 5x

Mode = 15x - 8x

Mode = 7x

Ratio of mode and mean = 7x ∶ 4x
